columns.name: connection
columns.comment: Type of connection used, e.g., database name.

columns.name: task_type
columns.comment: Type of task executed, e.g., SQL operation.

columns.name: project_key
columns.comment: Identifier for the associated project.

columns.name: task_data
columns.comment: JSON object with job and activity details.

columns.name: user
columns.comment: User who initiated the task.

columns.name: start_time
columns.comment: Timestamp when the task started.

columns.name: end_time
columns.comment: Timestamp when the task ended.

columns.name: job_project_key
columns.comment: Unique identifier for the job project.

columns.name: job_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each job execution.

columns.name: time_start
columns.comment: Timestamp when the job started.

columns.name: time_end
columns.comment: Timestamp when the job ended.

columns.name: stable_state
columns.comment: Indicates if the job reached a stable state.

columns.name: state
columns.comment: Current state of the job execution.

columns.name: warnings_count
columns.comment: Number of warnings generated during the job.

columns.name: scenario_project_key
columns.comment: Identifier for the scenario project.

columns.name: scenario_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for the scenario.

columns.name: scenario_run_id
columns.comment: Identifier for the scenario run instance.

columns.name: step_id
columns.comment: Identifier for the specific job step.

columns.name: step_run_id
columns.comment: Identifier for the step run instance.

columns.name: job_def_type
columns.comment: Type of job definition executed.

columns.name: job_def_trigger_type
columns.comment: Trigger type that initiated the job.

columns.name: job_def_initiator
columns.comment: Person who initiated the job.

columns.name: job_def_initiated
columns.comment: Timestamp when the job was initiated.

columns.name: job_def_refresh_metastore
columns.comment: Indicates if metastore was refreshed.

columns.name: job_def_outputs
columns.comment: JSON array of job output datasets.

columns.name: outcome
columns.comment: Result of scenario run, indicates success or failure.

columns.name: scenario_name
columns.comment: Descriptive name of scenario, provides context.

columns.name: trigger_name
columns.comment: Name of trigger initiating run, indicates start condition.

columns.name: scenario_run_as_user
columns.comment: User executing scenario, identifies responsible party.

columns.name: run_as_user_identifier
columns.comment: Identifier for user executing run, tracks user.

columns.name: run_as_user_via
columns.comment: Method or context of user execution, indicates access method.

columns.name: commit_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each commit.

columns.name: author
columns.comment: Name or identifier of the commit author.

columns.name: timestamp
columns.comment: Time when the commit was made, in milliseconds.

columns.name: added_files
columns.comment: Number of files added in the commit.

columns.name: added_lines
columns.comment: Number of lines added in the commit.

columns.name: removed_files
columns.comment: Number of files removed in the commit.

columns.name: removed_lines
columns.comment: Number of lines removed in the commit.

columns.name: changed_files
columns.comment: Number of files changed in the commit.
